# Glossary and Terminology

Short definitions for terms used across the tutorial. Expand as chapters land.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **body / link** | Rigid piece with mass and pose; URDF *link*, MJCF *body*. |
| **joint** | Model object connecting bodies (hinge, slide, ball, …); not the same as DoF count. |
| **DoF** | One scalar degree of freedom in `q` / `qvel` / `dq`; see [Joint vs DoF](rotations-and-frames.qmd#joint-vs-dof). |
| **nq / nv / nu** | MuJoCo: `qpos` length, velocity DoFs, actuator count — often equal on fixed arms, diverge with quaternions or under-actuation. |
| **geom** | Collision and/or visual shape attached to a body; not a degree of freedom. |
| **visual geom** | Mesh or primitive used only for rendering. |
| **collision geom** | Shape used for contact and constraints; often simpler than the visual. |
| **compound geom** | Several collision shapes on one link (capsules + boxes, multiple hulls). |
| **convex hull** | Smallest convex set containing a mesh; simulators use hulls for fast contact. |
| **soft contact** | Compliant contact: small penetration, spring–damper forces (MuJoCo; default Motrix on standard MJCF). |
| **hard contact** | Non-penetrating contact impulses (PhysX / Isaac default; Motrix optional via `_hard` geoms). |
| **watertight mesh** | Closed mesh with well-defined volume (every edge shared by two faces). |
| **contype / conaffinity** | MuJoCo bitmasks controlling which geoms collide with which. |
| **from_geom** | MuJoCo option to infer mass/inertia from geom density and shape. |
| **FK / IK** | Forward / inverse kinematics — joint coordinates ↔ poses. |
| **site** | Named frame on a body (EE, sensor origin); no mass. |

See also [References and external docs](references.qmd#references) and the dedicated [Geometry and collision](geometry-and-collision.qmd#geometry-and-collision) chapter for mesh and validation vocabulary. Process env vars: [Common environment variables](environment-variables.qmd#common-environment-variables).
